policy: A channel listing is not an endorsement or proof that a seller in Zambia can receive payouts. Verify official seller eligibility, country, age, fees, payment rails, refunds, taxes and terms before use. No account creation or contract acceptance for a minor.

channels.name: Direct social selling
channels.note: Use approved platform features and honest product descriptions; take orders through a verified, suitable payment method.

channels.name: Shopify
channels.note: Subscription and payment processor costs; do not assume Shopify Payments is available in Zambia.

channels.name: WooCommerce
channels.note: Core plugin is free; hosting, domain, extensions and payment gateway may cost.

channels.name: Payhip
channels.note: Requires a supported payment processor; official help lists multiple processors, availability varies by country.

channels.name: Gumroad
channels.note: Official payout help currently states Zambia creators cannot receive payouts through its listed local bank/PayPal routes. Do not build a sales plan around it without a verified lawful payout route.

channels.name: Ko-fi Shop
channels.note: Official help says payouts go directly to PayPal or Stripe; check whether either can lawfully receive funds in the seller's country.

channels.name: Etsy
channels.note: Check Etsy Payments country eligibility and seller age rules before considering.

channels.name: Fiverr
channels.note: Marketplace age rules and payout eligibility must be checked; no bypassing age requirements.

channels.name: Upwork
channels.note: Check minimum age, country and payout rules; no bypassing eligibility.

channels.name: Facebook Marketplace
channels.note: Availability, checkout and selling features vary by country; use local safe arrangements with appropriate adult oversight.

priority: Prioritise direct service sales and locally deliverable design work first; only add a storefront after confirming an actual payout path and legal eligibility.
